name: redact-pii
title: Redact PII
description: Mask personal data on your Mac with on-device AI by Desert Ant Labs, then restore the original values in replies.
author: canarian

commands.name: redact-clipboard
commands.title: Redact Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Redact the text on the clipboard and copy the result

commands.name: redact-selection
commands.title: Redact Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Replace the selected text in the frontmost app with a redacted version

commands.name: redact-text
commands.title: Redact Text
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Paste text, review what was detected, then copy or paste the redacted version

commands.name: restore-clipboard
commands.title: Restore Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Put the original values from the last redaction back into the text on the clipboard

commands.name: restore-selection
commands.title: Restore Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Put the original values from the last redaction back into the selected text

commands.name: forget-mapping
commands.title: Forget Last Redaction
commands.subtitle: Redact PII
commands.description: Delete the stored original values now; they are also deleted automatically after an hour

preferences.name: redactOrganizations
preferences.title: Organizations
preferences.label: Also redact company / organization names
preferences.description: ORG is detected but not redacted by default, since a company is not a natural person
